operations.semantics: Newest-to-oldest parsing stops at complete replacement+window checkpoint. Encountering newer incomplete checkpoint forces full replay even past older complete checkpoint. Canonical requested metadata replaces ancestor headers.

storage: legacy ThreadRolledBack record and earlier retained bytes
operations.semantics: Reverse reconstruction drops newest N user turns and related checkpoint state; raw persisted history still includes removed records. Cutoff indexing applies rollback before numbering users.

storage: new physical rollout retaining logical ID
operations.semantics: Requires unloaded paginated thread and ownership. BeforeTurn boundary retained by reference; persist replacement then compare-and-swap selected path. Logical fork cutoff can shrink.

operations.semantics: Resolve ordered immutable ranges; reject cycles, invalid managed paths/ownership and out-of-bounds positions. Include archived ancestors; retry alternative copy on failed ancestor reads.
operations.conditions: Existing / HistoryPage / PlainForReference resolution modes differ

operations.semantics: Live writer wins, then SQLite, then filesystem fallback. Paginated SQLite path authoritative to avoid selecting old revert generation. Include-archived explicit.
operations.conditions: legacy filesystem fallback; plain compressed sibling handling

storage: entire JSONL or zstd decoded stream
operations.semantics: Parse every nonempty line into vector; first SessionMeta canonical; retain copied later headers. Skip malformed records and legacy ghost snapshot. Reject unknown canonical history mode.
operations.conditions: legacy include_history path

operations.semantics: Metadata-only reads merge stored metadata and rollout facts; item retrieval is separate from full context and paginated projection.
operations.conditions: reader-specific fallback; complete field precedence deferred to storage owner

operations.semantics: Consume complete newline records incrementally. Skip malformed, unknown, missing/regressed ordinal; unknown only advances byte offset. Suppress copied subagent prefix while advancing projection. Projection is derived visibility.
operations.conditions: requires history DB; gaps and malformed input tracked as anomalies

storage: derived SQLite rows constrained by lineage
operations.semantics: List turns/items, timeline and search occurrences across bounded segments. Cursors carry requested logical scope and ordinal. Returned items are projected API objects, not every durable response/event occurrence.
operations.conditions: paginated validates mode/page size/cursor; history-page visibility differs for subagents/attached threads

operations.semantics: Captures fixed complete tail; After range demands contiguous original ordinals. Rejects reverted physical ID, fork/history_base, parent linkage, or subagent prefix.
operations.conditions: paginated root only; no universal incremental reader

operations.semantics: Plain reader seeks directly; compressed reader fully decodes opened physical file before reverse scanning frozen bound. Open handle/snapshot survives concurrent representation change.
operations.conditions: offsets always decoded original JSONL bytes; prefix validation separately optimized

operations.semantics: Startup creation-order cursor with lookback and pending recovery; busy skipped files retried, ordinary failures remembered for manual retry.
operations.conditions: BackgroundPaginatedRolloutMigration plus state DB; manual migration separate

operations.semantics: Narrow old-shape rewrites; retired records skipped; canonical header ordinal zero, later metadata omitted. Preserves effective conversation rather than raw bytes. Unsupported ResponseItem::Other fails canonicalization.
operations.conditions: legacy only; 16 MiB record cap skips oversized/malformed records

operations.semantics: Initial streaming attempt detects rollback; build ownership/replay plan then second pass removes rolled-back turns/markers and reduces checkpoints. Late completion ownership prevents naive suffix trimming.
operations.conditions: legacy ThreadRolledBack encountered

storage: bounded model context canonicalized as inherited prefix
operations.semantics: Prefer newest bounded checkpoint suffix; otherwise tolerant full replay. Rewrite child boundary to end of migrated content so preexisting inherited context is excluded from presentation. Bounded rewritten records use header timestamp.
operations.conditions: subagent migration kind

operations.semantics: Stage/sync, verify projection byte+ordinal coverage, check source size/mtime for old-writer changes, rename replacement, finish metadata, remove journal. Recover published partial handoff.
operations.conditions: compressed sources staged decoded then recompressed; migration rewrites unlike compaction

operations.semantics: Lock ownership; move selected and other owned physical generations into archive; restore moves on failure. Descendants passed by caller handled best effort after parent.
operations.conditions: active writer conflict; archive retains dependency ownership

storage: moved archived generations into dated active paths
operations.semantics: Restore selected/owned physical rollouts; parent mandatory, descendants best effort; return metadata-only root.
operations.conditions: requires valid dated rollout filename

operations.semantics: Reject attached children/external physical history references, subtract internal batch references. Cleanup under locks before files; state deletion after all files preserves retry graph.
operations.conditions: single or batch; reference index scan can grow with rollout population

operations.semantics: Public builder selects Local or InMemory in this revision; non-local test asserts no local rollout/SQLite writes. Core accepts ThreadStore abstraction. CCA originator labels identify provenance, not remote physical storage format.
operations.conditions: hosted storage implementation absent from reviewed public builder

projection_scalar_schemas.semantics: Canonical validated file: URI string; Windows drive uppercase normalization; encoded non-UTF8 bytes retained; native symlinks/filesystem aliases not resolved.
UTF8 path text preserved without interpreting/validating; native conversion may be lossy for non-UTF8 paths; relative text allowed.
Normalized absolute native path; deserialization of relative paths requires AbsolutePathBufGuard base; existence/canonical filesystem identity not implied.

projection_schema_notes: Named schemas preserve Rust field/variant spelling and exact serde attributes. Apply enclosing rename_all to compute JSON keys; explicit rename/default/skip/flatten/untagged take precedence.
Option<T> is nullable and ordinarily accepts absent fields, while skip_serializing_if governs omission. Do not infer omission from ts(optional), which only affects generated TypeScript.
Tuple path/ID wrappers and std Duration have explicit scalar schema entries. serde_json::Value is arbitrary JSON.
Registry keys are repository-relative source path plus ::RustType. Distinct API/core types with the same name deliberately have separate keys.
UserInput/model/MCP nested records overlap wire catalog ownership; this registry includes reachable declarations to keep projection inventory usable independently.
